children: MAN, Rheinmetall MAN Military Vehicles and Poland's WB Group agreed a strategic defence partnership on Tuesday to develop military mobility solutions for European armed forces.
The companies said they would combine MAN and RMMV vehicle platforms with WB Group's communications, reconnaissance and unmanned systems technologies.
